question: For the binary Weil descent of Semaev's S_3 (m=2, k=ceil(n/2)), measured by a second, independent closure implementation: (a) does d_F >= 5 hold on random-subspace instances at n=41-51 and on Semaev's polynomial subspace at n=47-51; and (b) does the last fall degree reach 6 on any of the 8 instances certified d_F >= 5 at n=33-37?

claims.text: On every recorded m=2 instance, the native closure gives the recorded last fall degree (exact, or >= 5 where the record says >= 5), and at D=4 the same closure rank as lfdclose2's W_4.
For each new instance, the native closure decides whether 1 lies in W_4 (d_F <= 4) or not (d_F >= 5, reported 'closure_only' until a checked certificate exists).
For each instance already certified d_F >= 5 at n=33-37 (T33a/b, R35a/b, U35a/b, R37a/b) the degree-5 closure decides 1 in W_5 (d_F = 5) or 1 not in W_5 (d_F >= 6, closure_only until certified).
Checked certificates (lfdclose2 + cert_check.py) for R39a/b, C21a/b and the new d_F >= 5 instances: a separate crypto-autoresearcher run, not this protocol.
Per (family, n) cell, the fraction of instances with d_F >= 5 is reported with a Clopper-Pearson interval; no trend in n is claimed from these counts.

hypotheses.statement: On random subspaces the last fall degree stays >= 5 for every n in 39-51.
hypotheses.mechanism: Random subspaces at n >= 35 already defeat degree 4 (Theorem 6.11); the degree-4 closure stalls with codim W_4 growing with n (4,888 at n=33 to 12,742 at n=45).

predictions.minimum_effect: every R instance at n=41-51 has 1 not in W_4

data_seen.measured: R: 2x>=5 at n=35,37,39; polynomial: 4 at n<=43, >=5 at n=45

hypotheses.statement: Some instance at n=33-37 has d_F >= 6.
hypotheses.mechanism: R35a is exactly 5 by branching; whether any other certified instance needs degree 6 is unknown. A 6 would be the first evidence that d_F grows past 5 at fixed m=2.

predictions.minimum_effect: at least one of the 8 certified n=33-37 instances has 1 not in W_5

data_seen.measured: W_4 dims and codim only; no W_5 computed

closureA rerun on R21a, R25a, R29a, R33a with RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4: closure ranks must be identical (determinism floor).

flags.closure: ReducedBasis::from_system_closed_full (full MutantXL at fixed degree = W_D)

arms.description: Every recorded instance with 1 in W_3 or W_4 (the calibrate stage): closureA must refute at the recorded degree.

instance_sampling.rule: per cell: R 3 instances at n=41,43,45,47,49,51; P 2 instances at n=37,39,47,49,51; the 8 named instances for C2; all recorded instances for C0; a draw with a Boolean solution is reported (kind satisfiable) and replaced by the next draw

blinding.how: not masked: outcomes are exact membership tests checked by an independent program

power.note: every claim is an exact per-instance computation (93 recorded + 28 drawn + 10 planted + 8 at D=5 + 4 A/A reruns, minus overlap); C4's intervals are descriptive (3 instances per R cell give a Clopper-Pearson lower bound of 0.29 at 3/3)

preflight_runtime.measured_on: pilot 2026-10-30 (4 vCPU): D=4 at n=33 (52,956 columns) 34-44 s; growth ~columns^1.9 from n=21; D=5 at n=21 (35,443 columns) 117-137 s. Extrapolated, not measured: D=4 at n=51 (~272k columns) about 1 h; D=5 at n=33-37 (284k-510k columns) several hours each on 16 CPUs

stopping_rules.rule: fixed design: run every listed cell once; D=5 closures only on the 8 named instances
a closure that exceeds its memory or 48 h limit is recorded as censored (no verdict) and not retried beyond the infrastructure limit
any positive-control miss or negative-control refutation stops the study: the instrument is faulty

invalidation_rules: every d_F >= D+1 row is 'closure_only' until C3's certificate exists; the paper states which
an A/A mismatch in any closure rank, or any C-calib disagreement, invalidates every new row from that binary
wall times are descriptive only (no isolation)

decision_rule.text: C0 must hold before any new row is read. C1: per instance, d_F <= 4 if 1 in W_4, else >= 5 (closure_only). C2: d_F = 5 if 1 in W_5, >= 6 (closure_only) if not. P1 holds if every admissible R instance at n=41-51 has 1 not in W_4; P2 holds if any named instance has 1 not in W_5.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: d_F per instance and certified codimension
